name: sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline: 22 atomic Socratic skills (survey → spec → design → data-model → api → tasks → tests → implement → review → ship). A living Now/Next/Later roadmap sits above the per-feature flow. A TDD implementation engine is included. The Q&A is depth-tunable (easy/medium/hard). Design is surface-aware (backend/web/mobile/desktop/CLI/worker/library as C4 containers). Every acceptance criterion is covered end-to-end. A copy-ready handoff block ends every stage. Skills are the open Agent Skills format (SKILL.md). The Claude-specific mechanisms degrade per skills/_shared/tool-adapters.md. Three skills close the outer loops: `refine` (an optional second pass that re-analyzes the codebase and corrects tasks/*.md + tasks.json atomically), `loop` (a gated, resumable six-phase polish loop over a single artifact), and `evolve` (mines _fixes/ + _review/ records for recurring prevention points and writes project-specific rules to docs/.skill-context/sdd-<skill>/SKILL.md that every skill reads at startup as a project-level override, without ever editing the installed skills).
